import os, signal, sys, time
os.setpgid(0, 0)
got = []
signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, lambda *a: got.append(1))
signal.signal(signal.SIGUSR1, lambda *a: sys.exit(0))
open('sentinel.ready', 'w').close()
while not got:
    try:
        time.sleep(0.05)
    except SystemExit:
        break
open('sentinel.out', 'w').write('got-int\n' if got else 'no-int\n')
